evals.prompt: 프로젝트 채팅방의 최근 메시지 10개를 읽고 결정된 내용만 요약해줘. 다른 채팅 내용은 보여주지 마.
evals.expected_output: kktcli readiness is checked, the exact chat is resolved through structured discovery, ten messages are read as JSON, and only the requested decisions are summarized.
expectations: Runs command -v kktcli and kktcli status before chat operations
Uses kktcli chats --json and then reads by chat_id with --limit 10 --json
Does not run send or send-image

evals.prompt: 고객지원 채팅방 최근 대화 좀 봐줘. 읽음 표시는 남기지 말고.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks kktcli chats --json, reads with --skip-unread so a room with unread messages is not opened (UNREAD_REFUSED), and explains that apart from the chat-list preview the unread messages cannot be read without marking them read.
expectations: Uses --skip-unread (or only the chats preview) so that no read receipts are sent
Recognizes the UNREAD_REFUSED error code from the JSON output
Explains that reading the unread messages would mark them read and offers the last-message preview instead

evals.expected_output: The exact chat is resolved, the message is previewed with --preview, the user's explicit request covers this text, and the actual send runs once and is reported from its JSON (sent, bubble_verified).
expectations: Resolves an unambiguous chat_id before sending
Runs the exact text through --preview before the actual send
Runs the actual send no more than once and reports success only from its result

evals.prompt: 디자인팀 채팅방에 보낼 /tmp/review.png 이미지 전송 명령을 준비해줘. 아직 이미지는 보내지 마.
evals.expected_output: The recipient and image are checked with send-image --preview only; the real send-image is not run because the user asked for preparation only.
expectations: Uses send-image --preview (or only explains the command) instead of sending
Does not execute the real kktcli send-image
Notes that sending still needs the user's explicit 보내 and their on-screen confirmation
